row.name: Plcc Play, Learn, Construct & Conserve Child Care Center

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The First Aid Kit from 1 of 2 transportation vehicles was incomplete. The following items were missing: Scissors, thermomemter, and tweezers.     Note: This was CORRECTED during inspection as the missing items were obtained and placed in the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: An employee who conducts transportation did not have current training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined the operation allowed a caregiver to care for a group of children prior to receiving the notification of the person's background check eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver allowed an infant to fall asleep in a restrictive device (swing) for approximately twelve minutes before removing the infant from the device and placing the infant in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: While reviewing video footage it was observed that a caregiver in the infant room did not wash their hands after conducting a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: While reviewing video footage it was observed that a caregiver in the infant room did not wash an infant's hands after conducting a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined the operation allowed a caregiver to care for a group of children prior to receiving the notification of the person's background check eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver allowed an infant to fall asleep in a restrictive device (swing) for approximately twelve minutes before removing the infant from the device and placing the infant in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 of 10 children's records reviewed were missing the child's immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: The activity plans posted in the toddler room and preschool room were not labeled with the dates that the plan covers and the age group the plan is intended for.      Note: The plans were labeled with the required information during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver was missing annual training for training year 7/7/2024 - 7/6/2025 on the following topics:     (1) Prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment;    (2) Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma;     (3) Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS);     (4) Understanding early childhood brain development;    (5) Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations;     (6) Administering medication;     (7) Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction; and     (8) Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with ?746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no written feeding instructions available for review for a 6 month old infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Two caregivers counted in child/caregiver ratio did not have the required eight hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: 1 of 10 children's records reviewed was missing the Name, address, and telephone number of the child's physician or an emergency-care facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director and a caregiver who conducts transportation did not have current training in transportation safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): 5 Of 6 personnel records reviewed were missing the a Pre-Employment Affidavit for Applicants for Employment at Certain Child Care Operations (Form 2912).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There was one caregiver caring for 5 infants. The specified age for the group was 0-11 months which allows 4 infants to 1 caregiver. Note The ratios were left in compliance as an additional caregiver was put in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two caregivers who have unsupervised access to the group of children do not have a CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: An employee in charge of transportation does not meet minimum qualifications for caregivers as she does not have verification confirming education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: The sign in and out log was not maintained.    Corrected at Inspection: The times and initials were placed for those who had not been sign in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The sign in/out log for was not current. There were 24 children present and only 12 were signed in.     Corrected at Inspection: All children were signed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age: There was no crib for an 11 month old infant. The infant was asleep on a mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: There were 4 infants (0-11 months) asleep in their cribs and were covered with a blanket.    Note: The blankets were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Recite:   There was one caregiver caring for 6 infants. The specified age for the group was 0-11 months which allows 4 infants to 1 caregiver.     Note The ratios were left in compliance as an additional caregiver was put in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An employee was present at the operation unsupervised with a group of children without an eligibility background check result.  Note: The employee left during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver hired did not have the 24 annual training hours for training period, 11/2021-11/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There are three ceiling tiles with water stains in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: A caregiver hired on 4/20/23 did not have the 24 hours of Pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: A caregiver hired on 9/26/23 did not a have CPR training and was unsupervised with a group of children. A caregiver hired on 4/20/23 did not have a CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee: Three caregivers did not have documentation for the 24 hours of Pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Three caregivers conducted an online CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The vent in a classroom was observed with dust and debris.  Corrected at Inspection: The vent was cleaned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product certification form was not current. Corrected at Inspection: The form was reviewed, signed, and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Operation did not have a current fire inspection. Last fire inspection conducted was on 06/09/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The cots used by the children were not labeled.     Corrected at Inspection: The cots were labeled with the children's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Director did not have a current transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: The safety documentation for fire drills, fire extinguishers, and smoke detectors is not being completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Loose fill surfacing (mulch) was not observed to be maintained at the proper depth for a play structure in the outdoor play area. The dirt underneath the mulch was visible.    Corrected at Inspection: The structures were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A Food Allergy Emergency Plan for a child was not signed by the parent and health care professional.
